description: Kotlin class A2UIHandler for managing interactions between Android app and web-based A2 UI, including URL resolution, readiness checks, and message decoding/validation.

classes.name: A2UIHandler
classes.description: Handles communication and UI message processing for A2 UI within an Android app context.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if the provided URL is trusted for A2 UI actions.

methods.name: resolveA2uiHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves the host URL for A2 UI based on provided node and operator URL functions.

methods.name: ensureA2uiReady
methods.description: Ensures the A2 UI is ready, possibly waiting for it to become available.

methods.name: decodeA2uiMessages
methods.description: Decodes and validates A2 UI messages from JSON input.
